resolution_notes: base_url: incorrect. BambooHR's current Technical Overview says API URLs begin with https://{companyDomain}.bamboohr.com/api/. Its official changelog says the July 3, 2025 routing change replaced https://api.bamboohr.com/api/gateway.php/{companyDomain}/ and directs new integrations to the company-domain format. Evidence: https://documentation.bamboohr.com/docs/api-details and https://documentation.bamboohr.com/docs/past-changes-to-the-api
